expectations.text: The page reuses the existing Button component and the CSS variables from theme.css (e.g. var(--color-accent), var(--color-surface)) instead of introducing new hard-coded colours or fonts
expectations.evidence: SettingsPage.jsx does `import { Button } from "./Button.jsx"`, and settings.css uses only theme variables such as `var(--color-surface)`, `var(--color-accent)` and `var(--font-ui)` with no raw colour or font values; the new colours (e.g. `--color-border: #334155`) were added as tokens in theme.css r

expectations.text: Form inputs have associated labels (label elements or aria-label) and the toggle is keyboard-accessible
expectations.evidence: Both inputs have labels, `<label ... htmlFor={nameId}>Display name</label>` and `<label ... htmlFor={notifyId}>Email notifications</label>`, and the toggle is a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` with a `:focus-visible` outline, so Space and Tab work normally.
